18 weeks, as squares.

Home shows the last 18 weeks of your shared diary.
Three colors: you, them, and the days you both wrote.
It counts the days in a row, too.

#couples #couplegoals #sharedjournal #couplesapp #relationshipgoals #dailyhabits #DearApp
en.threads: Three colors, not one. The days only one of you wrote look different from the days you both did — that difference is the whole reason it's on the home screen.
